title: Undead
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Scope (user, 2026-09-30): every undead family placed or spawned as an enemy, draugr included. Vampires are a sub-group here (user, 2026-10-02); the gargoyles are under World Creatures → Monsters. Ash is undead by the user's call (2026-10-01). An undead that exists only as a summon is under Conjured. Every Undead page is now in the census: five sub-groups (Vampires, Draugr, Skeletons, Ghosts, Ash), plus the Dragon Priests and the two Creation Club families, which sit directly in this group.

families.holds: the eight Skyrim priests, Vahlok the Jailor, the three Solstheim acolytes (Ahzidal, Dukaan, Zahkriisos) and the generic Dragon Priest
the Creation Club Zombies pack: six rungs Zombie 1 → Dread Zombie 40, their list and its runtime injectors
the Creation Club Ayleid Wights and Wight Lords of Rielle (draugr-levelled) and Norion the Undying
